description: This file defines the SearchForm class used for rendering and managing the search interface in a SuiteCRM module. It includes methods for initializing search parameters, populating search fields from user input, generating SQL WHERE clauses for searches, and rendering search headers, bodies, and tabs. The class interacts with metadata and saved searches, enabling complex search functionalities within the CRM.

classes.name: SearchForm
classes.description: A class providing functionalities to display, populate, and generate search forms and corresponding SQL conditions in SuiteCRM.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the SearchForm object, loads metadata, and sets up tabs and template variables.

methods.name: populateFromArray
methods.description: Populates search fields based on an input array, supporting different search contexts like basic, advanced, and saved views.

methods.name: populateFromRequest
methods.description: Populates search fields directly from the global $_REQUEST array.

methods.name: generateSearchWhere
methods.description: Generates SQL WHERE clauses based on current search field values to be used in database queries.

methods.name: displayTabs
methods.description: Render the navigation tabs for different search modes.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Prepares the form, loads templates, assigns variables and prepopulates fields for rendering.

methods.name: displayHeader
methods.description: Displays the search form header, including tabs and layout options.

methods.name: displayWithHeaders
methods.description: Displays the search form with headers and different search mode sections.

methods.name: displayBasic
methods.description: Render the basic search form interface.

methods.name: displayAdvanced
methods.description: Render the advanced search form interface, including saved searches if applicable.

methods.name: displaySavedViews
methods.description: Render the saved searches or views subform.

methods.name: getButtons
methods.description: Generate HTML for search, clear, and saved view buttons, including scripts for toggling search modes.
